summary: Rewrite a two-parameter function declaration into typed direct-call and partial-application overloads.

capabilities.requirement: Support the automatic currying behavior from the playground.
Intercept a core function declaration only in an opted-in lexical scope.
Keep parameter names and types aligned when the macro emits signatures and implementation code.
Emit overload declarations that preserve direct and partial call types.
Bind the delayed parameter in the returned closure without capturing an outer same-spelled name.

syntaxNotes: The first contract accepts named functions with two typed parameters and an explicit return type.
One argument returns a unary function; two arguments execute the body.
The implementation checks the second argument against undefined, so an explicit undefined follows partial-call behavior.

openDecisions.question: Permit a lexical function shadow to emit TypeScript overload declarations?
